{{Top|leg}}
A '''thrust vector magnet''' was a component on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a heavily modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], was equipped with at least one. An effective, though unorthodox, method of reattaching a thrust vector magnet in-flight involved [[medical adhesive tape]] and [[packing foam]].
